title: Mustard Seed Hustle
author: The Bard of Bizarre
blurb: You are a mustard seed, the smallest thing in all the land, with the greatest feet. Hop out of your mound and across the garden, push roots deep down in the dust for water, move a mountain with tiny faith and grow all the way up to the palm of God's hand. Shareware from The Sofa BBS, based on the song by The Bard of Bizarre, one of his gospel oddities (lyrics written by ChatGPT from Lewis Moten's prompt; music made with Riffusion, now Google Flow Music; animated cover made with Producer.ai).
